 Letter of Recommendation 
 
 Our ref: 129 2026-03-31 
 
 This office has engaged M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. for the work "Anganwadi Centre - Gujarat
 Pkg-151" (INR 2.50 Cr), completed on 2020-06-03. On the basis of that engagement we record the following:
 
 • Adherence to the sanctioned programme of work and milestone dates;
 • Quality of workmanship accepted at inspection without material objection;
 • Compliance with safety and statutory obligations on site; 
 
 • Responsiveness of the contractor's site management. 
 We confirm that National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. executed the referenced work to our satisfaction. Their
 performance on schedule, quality, and safety was commendable. 
 
 Verification: Asha Kapoor, ee@dept.gov.in, +91-9830000000.
